title: Service Request Frequency Loading on Rental Late Renewals
content:
Four or more service requests placed on a contract in the twelve months before its late renewal load the Rental Property Service Contracts late-renewal premium by 0.05; two or three load it by 0.02. This request-frequency loading reads the requests as follows.

| Service requests placed on the contract in the 12 months before the late renewal | Loading |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.05 |
| 2 or 3 | 0.02 |
| fewer than 2 | 0 |

**Records read.** The contract's service requests and their request dates; every request placed in the window counts, whoever placed it and whatever its outcome.

**How the loading acts.** Every loading and credit on a late-renewal premium enters one adjustment rate — loadings added, credits subtracted — and the premium is multiplied once by one plus that rate, before rounding.

## Boundaries

| Requests in the window | Loading |
|---|---|
| 1 | 0 |
| 2 | 0.02 |
| 3 | 0.02 |
| 4 | 0.05 |
